purpose: Editorial scene recommendations for the stable thirty talking-head styles. Categories are multi-use and do not imply that a new rendered video is accepted.
selection_policy: Tell the Agent the stable style ID or exact name in conversation; the workbench contains no input, rating, notes, persistence, or submission controls.

categories.name: 开场钩子
categories.description: 先抓住问题、反常识或悬念。

categories.name: 观点强调
categories.description: 把重要词、立场和语义重音读出来。

categories.name: 解释与步骤
categories.description: 让概念、步骤和信息层次更清楚。

categories.name: 证据与数据
categories.description: 让案例、截图和数字支撑口播观点。

categories.name: 转折对比
categories.description: 表现前后差异、否定和情绪转折。

categories.name: 收尾行动
categories.description: 收束要点，并给出一个清楚的下一步。
